bug.actual_behavior: The first new event is appended with a different project root hash, immediately making the ledger invalid; later appends fail and stale-tail repair refuses because prev_event_hash is valid.
evidence: bac verify reports project.root_hash changed within ledger; bac repair stale-tail refuses because there is no prev_event_hash mismatch.
bug.expected_behavior: A valid existing ledger should support a new contribution event after the project initializes Git, or provide a supported root identity migration command.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Initialize a BAC ledger before Git metadata exists.
Initialize Git or otherwise establish repository identity, then append one BAC record.
Run bac verify and observe project.root_hash changed within ledger.
bug.summary: BAC ledger cannot append after repository identity changes from uninitialized to Git-managed
bug.workaround: Back up the ledger, remove only the newly appended invalid tail event from the container, verify the original ledger, and omit new records until root identity migration is supported.
